name: NFTG
fix_description: setMainContract (0x3ded33bc / func_0260) has NO access control. It directly sets storage[0x05] and storage[0x06] (token contract addresses) without any owner check. Attacker calls it to set a malicious contract address, then uses swap to drain real tokens. Fix by adding onlyOwner modifier like setSalePrice has (func_13C2 check).
difficulty_reasoning: This PoC is a very short flash-loan wrapper around a simple repeated-call abuse: borrow USDT, loop transfers plus a direct low-level call to the vulnerable contract, repay, and keep profit. It requires little protocol-specific reasoning, uses only a couple of contracts, and an experienced auditor could reproduce it quickly once the vulnerable function is identified.
